info.title: Tikkit API
info.description: Self-hosted IT ticketing API. Product endpoints live under `/api/v1`. Every non-2xx response uses the `ErrorBody` shape; see docs/api.md.

servers.description: Same origin as the web app

get.summary:
Readiness probe. Unlike other endpoints, a 503 here carries the
`Readiness` body (not `ErrorBody`) so orchestrators and operators can see
which check failed.

503.description: A required dependency is not ready

get.summary: The OpenAPI document of this API.
Lists accounts ordered by normalized username.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of username, display name or email (max 100).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`.

patch.summary: Changes an account's role. Takes effect on the account's next request.

get.summary: Lists teams ordered by name (not paginated; teams are few).

200.description: Teams with lead and current members

post.summary: Creates a team and appoints its lead atomically.

409.description: `team_membership_conflict` (the lead already belongs to a team)

post.summary: Archives a team and ends all memberships. Refused while open tickets remain.
Replaces the team's lead atomically (never co-leads, never leaderless).

delete.summary:
Removes a plain member (the lead must be replaced first). Clears the
member's open assignments in this team.

post.summary:
Signs in with username and password. Always creates a new session; a
session cookie sent with the request is revoked (session fixation
defence). Unknown usernames, wrong passwords and deactivated accounts get
the same `401 invalid_credentials`.

200.description: Signed in; sets the session cookie

post.summary:
Signs out: revokes the presented session server-side and clears the
cookie. Idempotent (204 without a session too).

204.description: Signed out; clears the session cookie

get.summary:
The current session. This is the source of truth for the signed-in UI
state (e.g. after a page refresh).
Whether first setup is still open.

post.summary:
Creates the initial Admin account and signs it in. One-time: after it
succeeded (or concurrently with a winning attempt) it answers `409
setup_completed`. All later accounts require an invitation.

201.description: Admin created and signed in; sets the session cookie

Account.description: The signed-in account's own view of itself.

email.description: Contact address only; not unique and never used to identify accounts.

specialization.description: Specialist field designation; grants no access.

oneOf.description: The current team membership, `null` when the account has no team.

username.description: As entered at creation (trimmed); login compares the normalized form.

accountId.description: An active Operator, Specialist or Team Lead account without a team.

AdminAccount.description:
Admin view of an account. Accounts are identified by `id` and `username`;
`email` is contact information only and may be shared by several accounts.

AssignmentQueue.description: Where a ticket currently is, as shown to its requester.

replacementLeadId.description:
Required when the account currently leads a team and the new role is
not `team_lead`: this Team Lead account takes over in the same change.

specialization.description: Specialists only (1–100 characters); omit or `null` to clear.

leadAccountId.description: An active Team Lead account without a current team.

name.description: 1–100 characters after trimming; unique among active teams.

ErrorBody.description: Response body wrapper for every error: `{"error": {...}}`.

ErrorCode.description:
Stable, language-independent error codes. Serialized as snake_case.

Adding a variant is a contract change: update `openapi.json`
(`UPDATE_OPENAPI=1 cargo test --locked -p tikkit-api openapi`), regenerate
the web client and add English and German messages in
`apps/web/src/api/errors.ts` (the TypeScript build fails until you do).

message.description: Safe English fallback message. Never contains internal details.

requestId.description: Same value as the `x-request-id` response header.

FieldError.description:
One invalid field. `field` uses the request's camelCase names with `.`
for nesting and `[n]` for array items (e.g. `screenshots[0].name`).

params.description: Interpolation values for the translated message (e.g. `{"min": 3}`).

FieldErrorCode.description: Stable per-field validation codes. Serialized as snake_case.

status.description: Always `ok` while the process serves requests.

Language.description:
Interface/notification language. English is the fallback. A language
choice never influences authorization or business rules.

items.description:
Admin view of an account. Accounts are identified by `id` and `username`;
`email` is contact information only and may be shared by several accounts.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.

PreviousLead.description: What happens to the previous lead when leadership is handed over.

PublicTicketAssignment.description:
Public assignment details for requester-facing ticket responses.

Deliberately contains only display values: no team/account ids,
usernames, emails, or roles. `team` and `assignee` are always present and
`null` when not set, so "general queue" and "unassigned" are explicit.

accountId.description: An active Team Lead account in no team or already in this team.

oneOf.description: What happens to the previous lead (default `keep_as_member`).

Role.description: Account role. Exactly one per account; see spec.md "Roles".

SessionInfo.description: The current session: who is signed in and until when.

expiresAt.description:
Absolute expiry of the session (UTC). The session also ends after 12
hours without activity.

password.description: 12–256 characters, not equal to the username.

username.description:
3–32 characters of `[a-z0-9._-]` after trimming, NFKC normalization
and lowercasing. Stored as entered (trimmed) for display.

setupRequired.description:
`true` until the initial Admin has been created. Never becomes `true`
again.

Team.description:
Admin view of a team with its designated lead and current members
(ordered by username). Archived teams have no lead and no members.

session_cookie.name: tikkit_session
session_cookie.description: HttpOnly session cookie set by setup/login. Named `__Host-tikkit_session` in production.

tags.name: admin
tags.description: Organization administration (Admin only): account directory, roles, teams and leadership.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Login, logout and the current session. Unsafe requests need `Origin: <PUBLIC_ORIGIN>`.
